title: ISO 27001:2022 A.5.24 Incident management planning and preparation
text: Incident management planning and preparation. Plan and prepare for managing information security incidents by defining processes, roles, responsibilities, and communication. The response plan should name who can approve containment and what the escalation path is.

title: ISO 27001:2022 A.5.25 Assessment and decision on information security events
text: Assessment and decision on information security events. Assess information security events and decide whether they are incidents. Triage uses consistent criteria, including severity, confidence, affected assets, and whether the activity deviates from the baseline.

title: ISO 27001:2022 A.5.26 Response to information security incidents
text: Response to information security incidents. Respond to incidents using documented procedures. Containment should be proportionate, reversible where possible, and recorded with the evidence that justified it.

title: ISO 27001:2022 A.5.27 Learning from information security incidents
text: Learning from information security incidents. Use incidents to strengthen controls, update risk assessments, and improve detection. Assign corrective actions and verify they close.

title: ISO 27001:2022 A.5.28 Collection of evidence
text: Collection of evidence. Establish procedures for identification, collection, acquisition, and preservation of evidence related to information security events, in line with legal and internal requirements.

title: ISO 27001:2022 A.8.15 Logging
text: Logging. Produce, store, protect, and analyse logs of activities, exceptions, faults, and other relevant events. Network flow metadata, authentication events, and detection outcomes belong in the evidence set.

title: ISO 27001:2022 A.8.16 Monitoring activities
text: Monitoring activities. Monitor networks, systems, and applications for anomalous behaviour and take appropriate action. Alerts must be evaluated by a responder; an unmonitored queue is not monitoring.

title: ISO 27001:2022 A.8.20 Networks security
text: Networks security. Secure, manage, and control networks to protect information and connected systems. Segmentation and controlled egress limit lateral movement and give containment points.

title: ISO 27001:2022 A.8.21 Security of network services
text: Security of network services. Define, implement, and monitor security mechanisms, service levels, and service requirements for network services, including those provided externally.

title: ISO 27001:2022 A.8.22 Segregation of networks
text: Segregation of networks. Separate groups of information services, users, and information systems on networks. Segregation reduces the blast radius of a compromised host and restricts discovery.

title: ISO 27001:2022 A.8.23 Web filtering
text: Web filtering. Manage access to external websites to reduce exposure to malicious content. Web filtering is also a containment point for command-and-control and exfiltration destinations.

title: ISO 27001:2022 A.8.7 Protection against malware
text: Protection against malware. Implement malware protection and monitor for malicious code, including network indicators and lateral movement. Detection should be paired with containment and recovery steps.
